title: Call parameter syntax profiles and recovery notes
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define a lightweight, versioned set of syntax profiles for model->tool function calls (JSON-first) and a recoverable error mapping that runtime and SDKs can use to provide actionable repair hints and optional autofix transformations. Goal: reduce failed tool invocations from malformed params by 60% and avoid noisy dev flux during rollout of structured-output features.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Runtime exposes a profile selector header that maps requests to a validation profile version (e.g. profile=v2).
A2: Validation returns structured error codes in the existing call telemetry envelope and a human-friendly message plus one autofix suggestion when available.
A3: SDKs (JS & Python) can apply an optional 'repair' mode that performs non-destructive fixes for 3 common classes: minor type coercion, missing optional fields, and top-level enum normalization.
A4: Backcompat toggle available: legacy_profile=true to run older permissive checks for existing customers during migration window.
A5: E2E tests covering 120 prompt->call permutations with expected validation outcomes are added to CI.
work_log: 2026-02-22: Kickoff — doced initial profiles and gathered sample tool schemas from 6 internal teams (console, embeddings, reranker, billing, exec).

2026-02-28: Spike complete — implemented validator prototype using ajv with a schema preprocessor that accepts 'soft' types (string->number coercion rules). Performance: 95th p95 validation latency = 0.9ms per call on dev VM.
2026-03-03: Design review — PM and design requested clearer error language and example snippets for SDK error UI. Added 'repair suggestion' field concept.
2026-03-07: Engineering review — debated whether to include autofix by default; consensus: off by default, opt-in per-API key or SDK flag.

2026-03-12: Integration test added for JS SDK repair mode. Found an edge case with nested arrays where coercion produced ambiguous types; added deterministic tiebreaker (prefer string arrays when mixed).
2026-03-14: Preparing PR for runtime-1.20 branch with validator binary and telemetry hooks.
test_plan: Unit: validator accepts schema fixtures (positive/negative) for each profile version.
Integration: simulate prompt->tool loop with injected malformed params and assert telemetry contains error_code + repair_hint.
Load: validate performance with 1000 TPS synthetic traffic, ensure median added latency <1.5ms.
Chaos: enable legacy_profile toggle to 100 users and compare error rates for 2 weeks.
Backward compat: run existing callers in permissive mode for 30 days before enforcing profile=v2.
error_catalog_excerpt: ERR_CALL_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: top-level shape mismatch. message: 'Expected object with keys [to, subject] but found string.' repair_hint: 'Wrap value in {"to": ..., "subject": ...} or use repair_mode to attempt automatic wrapping.'

ERR_PARAM_TYPE_COERCE_FAIL: type coercion failed for field 'timeoutMs' (expected integer). message: 'Provided value "30s" could not be coerced to integer.' repair_hint: 'Use numeric milliseconds or let SDK repair by enabling numeric parsing.'

ERR_ENUM_NORMALIZATION: enum value not recognized. message: 'Received "fastest" but expected one of [low,balanced,high].' repair_hint: 'Map common synonyms (fastest->high) when repair_mode is enabled or return explicit suggestions.'

ERR_ARRAY_SHAPE_AMBIGUOUS: nested array contains mixed scalar/object types. message: 'Ambiguous element types in items[2].' repair_hint: 'Prefer using object wrappers for heterogeneous types; repair_mode will coerce scalars to {value: scalar} when safe.'

ERR_MISSING_REQUIRED_KEY: required key 'payload' missing. message: 'Call missing required key payload at root.' repair_hint: 'If payload is optional in profile=v1 but required in v2, consider legacy_profile toggle.'
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (canary): enable profile=v2 validation in canary region for internal teams only (1 day).
Stage 2 (beta): open to 5% of external traffic with telemetry alerts to #runtime-ops (7 days).
Stage 3 (gradual): 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks with automatic rollback on >5% regression in successful call rate.
Fallback: legacy_profile flag available per API key; automated migration email to customers with failing calls.
notes_for_qa: When testing repair_mode, assert that fixed payloads are returned in logs under 'validation.autofix' and that original input is preserved in 'validation.original'.
Verify that enabling legacy_profile prevents required-key failures for older clients.
Confirm SDK opt-in behavior: repair_mode=false by default, add CLI toggle for local testing.
Check that error messages are localized-ready (do not bake UI links into message text).
